name: waypoints
description: After each turn, up to three likely next prompts as quiet rows above the prompt box. 1-3 put one in as a draft you edit, Tab takes the first, 0 hides them. Nothing is ever sent for you.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: No suggestions after an answer shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Give the suggester this session's skills and slash commands, so a suggestion can be one of them.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Language of the band's own words (the hint and the key line). Suggestions follow the conversation's language either way.
